lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Pb2 (Y4Pb4 per unit cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with eight atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Pb and Y centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors: Pb is surrounded by 4 Pb and 8 Y, while Y is surrounded by 8 Pb and 4 Y, with neighbor distances ranging from 3.2226 to 3.4113 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that Pb–Pb and Y–Y 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, while Pb–Y pairs share corners and edges.
